description: Header file defining the QuicArenaScopedPtr class, a unique_ptr-like smart pointer for managing objects that may originate from an arena allocator, with support for arena-specific behaviors and custom destructor handling.

classes.name: quic::QuicArenaScopedPtr
classes.description: A smart pointer that manages objects potentially allocated from an arena, supporting arena-aware destruction and ownership semantics.

methods.name: QuicArenaScopedPtr
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the pointer to nullptr.

methods.name: QuicArenaScopedPtr(T* value)
methods.description: Constructor that takes ownership of a heap-allocated object.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Move assignment operator supporting move semantics from another QuicArenaScopedPtr.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer to the managed object.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator to access the object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Member access operator to access the object's members.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the managed objects between two pointers.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Replaces the managed object, properly destroying the previous one.

methods.name: is_from_arena
methods.description: Checks if the pointer originated from an arena.
